item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Dove 1.23.1
item.description:
macOS Smart Email Client

Dove by Canary Mail is an intelligent email client for macOS that integrates multi-account inboxes, AI-powered writing, email categorization, and schedule and task management into a single interface. The software can connect to Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Office 365, Exchange, and IMAP and POP3 mailboxes, allowing you to view all your emails in one place and manage your work and personal accounts separately. The AI summary helps you quickly grasp the key points of long emails. Intelligent search, combined with filters, helps you find emails and attachments. The writing assistant supports generating replies, rewriting and polishing text, adjusting tone, and translating. It can also prepare drafts for emails awaiting processing, which users can review before sending. The Inbox organizes information through the Focus, Feed, Noise, and Done sections. It also allows you to use natural language to create sorting rules, correct categorization results, or perform batch operations after previewing matching emails. The Today page centrally displays to-dos and schedules, and works with Gmail and Outlook calendars to handle meeting invitations, find free time, and schedule events.

item.title: uTools 8.0.2
item.description:
macOS Plugin Extension Toolkit

uTools is a tool platform that supports macOS, integrating AI application generation, a plugin application marketplace, and AI Agent invocation capabilities into a single interface. It is ideal for users who frequently handle files, images, documents, and repetitive business tasks. The platform has gathered over 5,618 plug-in applications, covering scenarios such as clipboard management, file search, Markdown, PDF tools, image processing, screen recording, batch processing of images and videos, batch renaming of files, and OCR text recognition, making it convenient to select tools as needed. With uTools AI, users don't need to know how to program. They can simply describe their ideas to generate their own applications and continuously modify them based on user feedback, ensuring the tools meet real-world work needs. Once the uTools MCP service is enabled, the AI Agent can automatically invoke plugin applications based on task requirements. Users can also convert business needs into dedicated tools, continuously optimize and solidify execution processes for repeated invocation by the AI Agent. Daily use supports global hotkeys to bring up features, and you can also use the floating ball to tap to bring up features, drag in files, or long-press to take screenshots, shortening the path from discovering a task to starting to work on it.

item.title: Burnstate 1.0.5
item.description:
macOSAI Programming Quota Monitoring

Burnstate is a native macOS menu bar tool for AI programming users that centralizes the limits and usage of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Vercel AI Gateway, and Setapp AI, helping developers keep track of conversation limits, weekly quotas, billing period usage, and credit balances. The software compares quota usage with the progress of the time window, displays the rate of usage, and predicts whether the quota will be used up before the reset, providing a more informed basis for work scheduling. It also integrates agent session status, uses non-intrusive floating cards to notify users of task completion, permission requests, and low credit warnings, and supports direct handling of Claude Code authorizations and multi-step issues. Cooldown schedules reminders for breaks, meals, and the end of the workday based on keyboard and mouse inactivity. Only time when you are actually away from the computer counts as a break. Upon returning, you can check the agent's progress. The software uses local logs to track tokens, model distribution, estimated costs, and usage trends. It can generate annual reports and share them via links or images. It also includes a desktop widget for real-time monitoring of limits.

item.title: Upto 1.3.2
item.description:
Mac App Update Manager

Upto is an application and command-line tool update management software for macOS. It automatically detects applications installed on a Mac, checks for updates from the App Store, Sparkle, Homebrew, TestFlight, Setapp, and other sources, and compiles the results into a single list. It can also manage command-line programs installed via tools such as Homebrew, npm, pipx, and uv, allowing users to view and upgrade them without opening the Terminal. Before updating, you can view the source, rating, and natively translated version notes, choose the stable or beta version, skip a version, or temporarily or permanently ignore specific apps. Upto supports batch updates and confirms major version updates. It can also be approved via Touch ID. Downloaded content is verified based on the developer's signature or checksum before installation, and it is not left in the Downloads folder after installation. Users can also set up scheduled checks, view updates via notifications or the menu bar, stop ongoing updates, and filter for apps that only support Intel or are no longer maintained.

item.title: BeyondNotes 1.0.1
item.description:
Mac Diary Software

Beyond Notes: Markdown Editor is a plain-text note-taking and Markdown writing app for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. It is ideal for keeping a diary, organizing meeting notes, planning weekly schedules, and gathering creative inspiration. When editing, headings, lists, bold text, and tables are formatted instantly. Once you move away from the editing area, the Markdown markup fades out, keeping the content clear and easy to read. Notes are stored as plain text files in the user's own iCloud Drive, can be synced across devices, can be opened in other text apps, and support bulk import and export. The software offers nested tags, full-text search, bidirectional links, and to-do checkboxes to facilitate the organization of information and the tracking of unfinished tasks. The diary feature allows you to quickly open the page for the current day, view recorded dates through the calendar, and review entries from the same day in previous years. Focus mode, text color that changes with typing speed, seven themes, and three font styles offer options for different writing habits. The built-in wording tagging tool identifies common machine-like expressions in English and Swedish on the device side, without the need for a language model.

item.title: Audiobook Author 1.0.1
item.description:
Mac Audiobook Audio Detection

Audiobook Author: Mastering is a macOS audio checking, correction, and export tool for audiobook creators. It analyzes recordings chapter by chapter according to the technical requirements published by retail platforms and clearly indicates why files have not met the standards. The software detects average or integrated loudness, peak levels, noise floor, room tone at the beginning and end of chapters, sample rate, number of channels, and duration. It can also check cover art dimensions, square aspect ratio, file type, and color space. The Pro version can automatically adjust the volume, use a look-ahead limiter to control peaks, and supplement room noise from the original recording. Issues that cannot be reliably processed automatically will be clearly indicated. After completing the check, you can convert MP3 files according to the target settings, such as outputting 192 kbps constant bitrate, 44.1 kHz mono files for ACX, or creating M4B audiobooks that include chapters, covers, and metadata. The app supports retail audio samples, batch processing, custom targets, and long background tasks, and reads the title, author, and narrator information on the cover. All processing is done natively on the Mac, with no account required, and no data is uploaded or collected;

item.title: Weather Events 2.0
item.description:
macOS Weather Calendar

Weather Events – for Calendar is a macOS app that saves daily weather as calendar events. It is ideal for recording daily weather, organizing travel experiences, and reviewing the weather conditions of a specific period in the future. The software lists the weather by day, presents an overview using emojis and the high and low temperatures, and includes a textual description in the event notes. Multiple emojis can be used on the same day to reflect changes in weather conditions, and the probability of precipitation, precipitation amount, and maximum wind gusts can also be recorded. The relevant information can be turned off as needed. Users can specify different locations for each day, use the same location as the previous day, or schedule weather records based on locations from existing calendar events, making it convenient for continuous business trips and inter-regional travel. When the weather forecast does not match how it actually feels, you can switch to custom values, edit events, and add notes in the app. You can also decide whether to show the location in the event. Weather events and settings are synced across multiple devices via iCloud. Past events are retained, and the app only updates records for the current day and onward. The interface supports row background colors and gradients that change with the weather, and is compatible with both light and dark appearances. No need to request location tracking permission. Simply select the forecast location manually to use it.

item.title: Music Cleaner 1.0
item.description:
macOS Music Library Cleanup

Music Cleaner is a macOS cleanup tool designed specifically for the Apple Music library. It finds and, if desired, removes references to tracks that have lost their original audio files. When music files are moved, renamed, or deleted, the corresponding entries may still remain in the library, and checking them one by one manually can be time-consuming. The software helps users quickly locate invalid records by scanning and listing the tracks with missing files. After the scan is complete, you can use the checkboxes to check each item and select the ones you want to remove, then confirm the cleanup. This makes the library cleanup process more intuitive. For track references that you wish to attempt to retrieve the original files for at a later date, or that you do not want to process for the time being, you can use the archive function to retain them, making it easier to arrange the scope of cleanup according to your actual needs. Removing tracks from the library cannot be undone, so carefully check the selected list before proceeding. During the first cleanup, macOS will request permission for Music Cleaner to control the Music app. The software supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs and requires macOS 14.6 or later. It is suitable for users who need to clean up invalid entries in their local music libraries.

item.title: Magic Cutter 2.1
item.description:
macOS Audio Editing Software

Magic Cutter – MP3 Editor is an audio editing tool for macOS that focuses on the fast trimming, splitting, and merging of MP3 and AAC files. The software supports audio cutting without re-encoding, avoiding sound quality loss due to repeated transcoding. It is suitable for extracting segments from long recordings, splitting music albums, or organizing audiobooks. Through the visual waveform interface, users can manually set cut markers or automatically split files based on file size, segment duration, a specified number of segments, or silence positions. The built-in silence detection feature helps identify chapter breaks and remove unnecessary pauses. Combined with CUE file support, it can split full-track albums or DJ mixes into individual tracks and automatically set track names and numbers. The software also offers trimming, fade-in, and fade-out functions, making it easy to create ringtones and adjust the start and end effects of clips. The built-in player allows for convenient preview listening. Version 2.1 updates the app icon and overall interface, fixes abnormal noise at cut points and fade-out endings, improves the retention of album covers and metadata tags, and adds a button to return to the start point.

item.title: Ice 2 3.1.0
item.description:
Hide macOS Menu Bar Icon

Ice 2 is an open-source menu bar management tool for macOS, developed from an independent branch of the original Ice. It helps users hide infrequently used app icons to keep the menu bar clutter-free. Hidden items are centrally displayed in the Ice Bar panel. Click the Ice icon to expand it, and then click an item to open the corresponding menu. While the menu is open, the app icon will temporarily return to its original position in the menu bar. Users can choose to show or hide items in the settings and adjust the order in which Ice Bar and the settings list are arranged by dragging and dropping. The software supports launch at login, an interface with eight language settings, hiding its own icon, and checking for and downloading updates via Sparkle. The automatic update check is disabled by default. The backup feature can save all settings, and when used in conjunction with a cloud storage folder, the configuration can be restored on other Macs. The software does not include telemetry, analytics, or crash reports, and only uses the network during updates. The current 3.0 series requires an Apple Silicon Mac and macOS 27 or later, as well as Accessibility permissions. macOS 26 users can use version 2.17.

item.title: GlassOTP 2.0.1
item.description:
Mac TOTP Verification Code Generator

GlassOTP is a lightweight offline two-factor authentication tool for macOS. It resides in the menu bar, allowing you to view and copy verification codes without opening a full window. It supports TOTP, HOTP, and Steam Guard. The software provides global keyboard shortcuts, search-as-you-type, arrow key selection, and Enter to copy. It supports prioritizing frequently used accounts, pinning accounts, and previewing and copying the next set of verification codes during the last five seconds of their validity period. You can add accounts by scanning QR codes on the screen, using a camera, images, PDFs, the clipboard, authentication links, or manual entry. You can also import account data from tools such as Google Authenticator, 2FAS, Aegis, Proton Authenticator, and Bitwarden. The secret key and recovery code are stored in the macOS Keychain. You can enable Touch ID or password protection for the entire list or individual accounts, and use password encryption to back up and store accounts, recovery codes, and HOTP counters.

item.title: MacOSCleaner 3.0.0
item.description:
macOS System Cleaner

MacOS Cleaner is a native system cleanup and application management tool for Apple Silicon Macs. It requires macOS 26 or later, is built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI, and offers features such as smart cleanup, application uninstallation, duplicate file detection, disk space analysis, process and startup service management, and privacy checks. The software can scan various types of files, including system caches, user logs, browser data, Xcode, Docker, Node, Python, Rust, Go, CocoaPods, AI models, and project build artifacts, and help completely uninstall software through analysis of application residual evidence. By default, deleted items are moved to the macOS Trash. The scanning process does not modify files. It includes built-in mechanisms for blocking protected paths and sensitive configuration files, allowing users to confirm before proceeding with cleanup. It also supports TCC permissions, network connection snapshots, and checks for multiple browser extensions. It provides native FoundationModels intelligent classification and explanation, does not rely on cloud services, and does not include telemetry, background daemons, or remote logs.

item.title: Phosphene 1.11.6
item.description:
Mac Custom Live Wallpaper

Phosphene is an open-source video wallpaper tool for macOS. Through a menu bar app and a system wallpaper extension, it adds user-imported videos to the wallpaper panel in System Settings, allowing custom dynamic backgrounds to be used on both the desktop and the actual lock screen, rather than simulating wallpapers with floating windows. The software supports MP4, MOV, and other video formats readable by AVFoundation, offering media library management, video information viewing, and optional optimization. It also reduces stuttering during transitions through frame-accurate seamless looping. Users can select wallpapers for different monitors and desktop spaces, preview the current image in the menu bar, pause playback, switch monitors, or set login startup. The playback policy reduces the load or pauses rendering based on temperature, battery level, power status, game mode, and lock screen and idle states. Rendering can also be stopped when the desktop is completely obscured by windows. Optional low-resolution, low-frame-rate video versions support automatic switching based on policies, while the lock-screen-only playback mode provides a smooth transition. The software requires macOS 26 or later and is compatible with Apple Silicon and Intel. Since it relies on Apple's proprietary wallpaper framework, major system updates may affect compatibility.

item.title: Warp 0.2026.11.18.08.17.stable_01
item.description:
Powerful Modern Smart Ai Terminal Tools

Warp is a modern terminal and intelligent coding environment for macOS developers that combines traditional command lines, AI coding agents, multi-model scheduling, and team-level governance capabilities in one workflow. Starting from the terminal experience, it supports developers to directly call Claude Code, Codex, Warp Agent and other agents locally. It can also extend the task to run in the cloud through the Oz Agent Platform, which is suitable for complex software engineering scenarios such as code generation, problem troubleshooting, refactoring migration, PR preliminary examination and incident response. Warp Terminal is open source, emphasizing an open agent ecosystem, connectivity to any tool, choice of inference providers and models, and providing codebase indexing, fine-grained permission control, usage visibility, and enterprise compliance capabilities to enable individual developers and teams to organize automated development tasks more efficiently in a familiar command-line interface.

item.title: clash-party/mihomo-party 2.0.5
item.description:
Clash Graphical Proxy Client

Mihomo Party is a user-friendly Clash graphical interface client designed to provide a more straightforward operating experience. Its main features include being ready to use out of the box, with no need to worry about permission issues or service mode settings. The software comes with built-in common configuration items, such as DNS and Sniff, so users don't have to manually edit configuration files. It also includes Monaco-editor, a powerful editor that makes it easy for users to edit or format configuration files. Mihomo Party supports one-click configuration backup and restore via WebDAV, and provides a configuration overwrite feature that allows users to freely modify subscription configurations to meet their personalized needs.

item.title: PureMac 3.3.0
item.description:
Open-source native system cleanup tool

PureMac is a native cleanup and app uninstaller for macOS that emphasizes transparent, reviewable, and recoverable cleanup processes, making it ideal for users who want to free up disk space without relying on exaggerated scan prompts. It can find residual content such as preferences, caches, containers, launch agents, and logs after an app is dragged in. It can also scan for orphan files left behind by apps that have already been deleted, and use intelligent scanning to process common sources of clutter such as system junk, user caches, Xcode DerivedData, Homebrew, npm, yarn, pnpm, Docker, and AI app logs. The software displays the actual path of each item to be processed, allowing users to confirm each item before deletion. All removal operations are sent to the Trash via the system interface, and items can still be recovered after accidental deletion. PureMac does not include telemetry, analytics, account, or network backhaul mechanisms, and employs a code-level exclusion strategy for high-risk system paths, making it suitable for Mac users who value privacy, security boundaries, and open-source transparency.

item.title: Open Island 1.3.3
item.description:
Lingdong Island AI Programming Vibe Agent Manager

Open Island is an open-source native AI programming agent control center for macOS developers. It can reside in the notch area or at the top of the screen, presenting agent session status, task progress, permission requests, and usage in real time with a compact interface, and supports one-click return to the corresponding terminal tab, split-screen pane, IDE workspace, or Codex desktop dialog. The software is built using SwiftUI and AppKit, prioritizing local availability and not relying on servers, accounts, or telemetry services. It automatically discovers sessions from local records and restores them after a restart. It can connect to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Kimi CLI, OpenCode, Qoder, Qwen Code, Factory, and CodeBuddy, and is also compatible with various development environments such as Terminal, Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm, tmux, Zellij, VS Code, and JetBrains.

item.title: KeyStats 1.57
item.description:
Menu bar to view keyboard and mouse statistics in real time

KeyStats is a lightweight native keyboard and mouse statistics tool for macOS and Windows. The macOS resident menu bar can record the number of keyboard keystrokes, left and right mouse clicks, mouse movement distance and page scrolling distance in real time, helping users understand daily computer operations and input habits. The core data is displayed directly in the menu bar, and the detailed statistics panel can be opened by clicking on the icon, eliminating the need to switch windows frequently. The software automatically resets the count of the day at midnight every day, and the statistics are still retained after the application restarts to facilitate continuous recording. In terms of privacy, KeyStats only stores summary statistics, does not record input text, key sequence or specific cursor and click location, and the data is saved locally by default. Users can turn on end-to-end encrypted multi-device synchronization on demand, synchronizing the total number of supported daily buttons, single and key combination counts, and mouse button clicks between paired devices; mouse movement distance, scrolling distance, and by application statistics are not currently involved in synchronization.

item.title: Cherry Studio 2.2.3
item.description:
Customize your own AI assistant

Cherry Studio is a Windows, Mac, and Linux-compatible desktop client that supports multiple major language model (LLM) providers. It not only integrates cloud services such as OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, but also supports the deployment of Ollama and LM Studio native models. Users can use the built-in 300 + preconfigured AI assistants, or custom create a dedicated assistant to talk to multiple models at the same time and get diverse perspectives. At the same time, the app supports a variety of document formats, including text, pictures, Office, and PDF, with WebDAV file management and data backup capabilities. Cherry Studio also provides useful tools such as global search, topic management, AI-driven translation, and ensures a quality experience with light and dark themes and transparent windows that can be used out of the box without additional configuration. Users who like Cherry Studio can support its development through Little Star or sponsored developers.

item.title: MiaoYan 4.11.0
item.description:
macOS Native Markdown Editor

MiaoYan is a lightweight Markdown laptop app designed to help users easily write beautiful sentences. It features purely local use for security while supporting features such as syntax highlighting, dark mode, and automatic document layout. Users can enjoy a minimalistic three-column design that includes folders, file lists, and an editor for a great visual experience. MiaoYan uses Swift5 for native development, outperforms traditional web applications, and provides a number of shortcuts to improve editing efficiency. Other features include document export, internal jumps, graph bed support, and support for LaTeX, Mermaid, PlantUML, and Markmap brainstorming, making it a versatile writing tool.

item.title: WallpaperMachine 1.14.0
item.description:
Native Dynamic Wallpaper Tool for macOS

WallpaperMachine is a native live wallpaper app for Macs with Apple silicon. It can run Wallpaper Engine's scene wallpapers, video wallpapers, and web wallpapers on macOS 15 Sequoia and later versions. The app features built-in browsing and downloading from the Steam Workshop, allowing you to browse a vast amount of content without logging in. To download, you need a Steam account with Wallpaper Engine. For scene wallpapers, you also need to purchase the shared resources separately during installation. The interface is divided into three tabs: Discover, Installed, and Settings. After selecting a wallpaper, press Play to apply it to the desktop. Each monitor can have its wallpaper set independently or mirrored from another monitor, and zoom, frame rate, and volume can be configured separately. After enabling audio response, wallpapers designed for sound will move in sync with the content currently playing on the Mac. Media integration allows wallpapers with music displays to show the song that is currently playing. When running on battery power, you can choose to keep running, reduce the load according to the custom rendering scale and frame rate, or pause directly. Videos and scene wallpapers can also be used experimentally for lock screen animations.

item.title: Bing Wallpaper 2.0.30.0
item.description:
macOS free wallpaper app

The Bing Wallpaper app lets you explore the world through a single image every day. Downloading this app will bring your desktop to life every day with beautiful images from around the world that have been featured on the background of Bing's homepage. This not only allows you to see different landscapes in front of your computer every day, but also allows you to browse through these pictures and learn where they come from, allowing you to gain insight and experience different cultures and nature while using your computer on a daily basis. Bring new life to your desktop every day by downloading Bing Wallpaper. Bing Wallpaper offers a selection of beautiful images from around the world that were featured on Bing's homepage. Not only will you see a new image on your desktop every day, but you'll also be able to browse through the images and learn where they came from. Discover a new place every day to bring your desktop to life.

item.title: FluxMarkdown 1.58.899
item.description:
Markdown Quick Preview QuickLook Extension

FluxMarkdown is a Markdown quick preview tool for macOS, designed for Finder's QuickLook scene, which allows you to view the content of a document instantly by pressing a space, without having to open the editor first. It can not only render common Markdown, but also supports Mermaid charts, KaTeX mathematical formulas, GitHub Flavored Markdown, directory panels, code highlighting, and a variety of chart syntaxes. It is suitable for programmers, technical writers, and document organizers to quickly confirm the layout and content structure when browsing files. The software also provides PDF and HTML export, scaling and panning, scrolling position memory, light and dark color, and system theme switching, and can adjust the rendering and editing experience through the settings window, and has high compatibility with a variety of Markdown-related extensions.

item.title: Hidden Bar 1.13.2
item.description:
Menu Bar Icon Hiding Tool

Hidden Bar is a tool for hiding macOS menu bar icons. How to use: Hold down the `⌘ Command` key in the menu bar, and two icons will appear, "｜" and ">". Then, drag the icon you want to collapse to the left of the "｜" icon. Click the ">" arrow icon to expand/collapse the menu bar icons. However, pay attention to a logical issue: the ">" icon cannot be placed to the left of the "｜" icon, as it cannot fold itself in.

item.title: Ghost Downloader 4.5.11
item.description:
Cross-platform, open-source, multi-threaded downloader

Ghost Downloader 3 is an open-source, cross-platform, multi-protocol download manager for macOS 13.0 and later. It is built using Python, Qt, and a Fluent Design-style interface and can run on Intel x86_64 and Apple Silicon arm64 devices. The software offers an IDM-like intelligent segmented download mechanism, eliminating the need for additional file merging after task completion, and incorporates AI-driven intelligent acceleration to enhance transfer efficiency. Supports resource types such as HTTP, magnet links, BT, FTP, M3U8, MPEG-DASH, and eD2k. It can also simulate the TLS fingerprints of real browsers, reducing the likelihood of download requests being blocked by anti-scraping mechanisms. With built-in YouTube and Bilibili video parsing capabilities, it can handle playlists, videos up to 4K HDR, subtitles, and login content, and provides dedicated parsing and mirror acceleration for GitHub Releases and Hugging Face models.

item.title: Notchi 0.9.41
item.description:
macOS Notch Smart Assistant

Notchi is a native macOS tool that transforms the Mac notch area into a shortcut for input and an intelligent task portal. Users simply move their mouse near the notch and enter natural language to jot down ideas, create time-based reminders, ask AI questions, or invoke a coding agent to handle project tasks. The software can recognize input intent, store ordinary content in memos, directly convert sentences like "Call Mom tomorrow at 9:00 a.m." into system reminders, and support online searches, source citations, clipboard screenshot recognition, and precise mathematical calculations. For development tasks, users can specify a project folder and describe their requirements, which are then executed in the background by the native Codex or Claude CLI. Even after the notch is closed, the current step and time elapsed are still displayed, and a system notification is sent when the task is completed. Notchi uses a Liquid Glass material that harmonizes with the macOS style, seamlessly integrating the panel and screen bezel through background blur, edge lighting, and fluid animations. The classification of the input is completed locally. The issue will be sent directly to the corresponding platform using the service provider key selected by the user, without passing through the developer's server.

item.title: Guitar Wiz 2.6.1
item.description:
macOS all-round guitar practice learning artifact

Guitar Wiz: Chords & Tuner is an all-in-one guitar companion app for Mac, iPad, and iPhone that combines mass and string libraries, real-time tuners, metronomes, chord aids, songwriting tools, and sheet music scanning. The application provides interactive chord graphs to support quick search by name, note or virtual fingerboard. Each chord is accompanied by finger suggestions, high-quality audio samples, and theoretical analysis of music to help users deepen their understanding of pitch, indexing, and common scenarios. The Chord Assist function uses the device microphone to monitor the performance in real time and illuminates the corresponding position of the fingerboard to improve accuracy; Interactive chord playing with built-in guitar, bass and drum accompaniment makes the practice more musical. Song Maker allows users to quickly build song structures, choose different styles of playback and export WAV files, while Songsheet Scanner uses computer vision to recognize printed chord scores and automatically save them to favorites. A daily chord, more than 20 alternative tunings, a menu bar shortcut metronome, and Apple Watch companion support keep your practice running through all-weather scenarios.

item.title: Tidyshot 2.7.3
item.description:
Smart Screenshot Auto Organizer

Tidyshot Screenshot Organizer is a screenshot management tool designed for Mac that sits quietly in the menu bar and monitors your screenshot folders in real time. When you capture a screen using the Mac's built-in snapshot tool or a third-party tool such as CleanShot or Shottr, Tidyshot automatically picks up the file in a few seconds, reads the text content on the screen through OCR technology, and intelligently generates a meaningful file name in combination with the name of the currently used application, such as changing the default timestamp file name to "figma-dashboard-header-component.png". At the same time, it moves files into a neat folder structure based on your settings, organized by source application, date, content type, or flattening so your desktop is no longer cluttered with cluttered screenshot files.

item.title: FletchShot 2.4.2
item.description:
macOS Screenshot Annotation OCR Tool

FletchShot is a screenshot annotation tool designed for macOS, aimed at those who need to quickly take screenshots, draw arrows, and share them instantly every day. As soon as you finish capturing, the annotation window opens immediately, and the arrow tool is selected. After drawing the arrow, grab the bottom edge label of the window and drag it directly into the Slack message Finder or Terminal, and it will be delivered as an image. You can also press Command+C to copy the content with annotations and paste it at any time. The entire process has no save dialog, no mode selection, and no export procedure. Scroll Capture allows you to scroll the target window yourself when long pages extend beyond the screen. The app stitches frames using ScreenCaptureKit, without the need for plugins, extensions, or accessibility permissions. Screen recording supports three modes: full screen, area, or window. Switch to click highlighting with one tap. The footer allows you to switch between MP4 and GIF formats and choose between high, medium, and low video quality. OCR runs on the device side based on Apple's Vision framework. It can extract error message tables, code, and even JSON on the screen as pastable text and automatically indent it. It prioritizes support for English and Japanese.

item.title: OnDevice OCR Pro 3.4.5
item.description:
Batch OCR tool for documents on macOS

OnDevice OCR Pro is an offline OCR and batch document processing tool for Mac that turns scans, images and PDFs into full-text searchable content. It runs entirely on your Mac with no cloud or subscription, so sensitive files stay local, which suits legal, medical, financial and office use. It can watch folders and process new documents automatically, with batch recognition, auto-rotation, image enhancement and smart skipping of already digital PDFs. Built-in multilingual OCR covers Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German and more, and it can extract text only to save disk space. It is well suited to invoices, receipts, contracts and research material.

item.title: Ember 1.6.12
item.description:
Private life diary software

Ember: Journal & Life Archive is a private logging tool that combines diary and interpersonal memory archives for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. When writing down daily, just mention a person in the text, and the relevant content will be gathered on the other person's personal page, gradually presenting the common experience, the time of acquaintance and the context of contact; You can also organize people by circles, such as home, work or campus, and use stories to record chapters of life that span many years. Dynamic retrospectives reimagine old memories on the right dates and gently remind you to keep an eye out for people you haven't been in touch with for a long time. The software provides calendars, maps, and people maps to help you navigate through life's snippets from dates, places, and networks, as well as support for searching text throughout your archives and photos. You can add photos, videos, voice memos, Apple Music songs, and weather, and import Day One, Apple Journal, and contacts. The diary is saved on the device and can be locked with Face ID, Touch ID or password and synced privately via personal iCloud;
